item.title: Check out Sesame Street’s ‘Knives Out’ parody, ‘Forks Out’!
item.description: Tonight we're coming at you with some unexpected light entertainment, in the form of this Knives Out parody from Sesame Street (courtesy of Netflix).

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #311 – Momentum and spaceships
item.description: Audio EXP #311 covers the Dragonmeet 2025 award winners, The Black Company RPG playtest, Fantasy Grounds legacy rewards and a Culture-inspired spaceship name generator.

item.title: Build the ultimate fantasy sandbox with the Worlds Without Number bundle
item.description: Bundle of Holding has a new deal for Worlds Without Number, the fantasy sandbox TTRPG from Kevin Crawford and Sine Nomine Publishing.

item.title: Check out this new ‘Lord of the Rings’ trilogy poster collection from Riccardo Federici
item.description: Almost 25 years after the Lord of the Rings trilogy from Peter Jackson first hit cinemas, Mondo is proving that the epic movies are still going strong in our hearts, by releasing these utterly stunning posters from Riccardo Federici.

item.title: Review: The War Between the Land and the Sea (Episodes 1 & 2)
item.description: Russell T Davies returns with a gripping Doctor Who spin-off. Our review of The War Between the Land and the Sea explores its eco-horror and political tension.

item.title: Start your morning with a Snorlax blocking the way to the coffee machine
item.description: EMP has released a 3D Snorlax mug. It holds 475ml of coffee and looks great, but it comes with a strict hand-wash-only warning.

item.title: Australia’s social media ban creates a digital divide for young roleplayers
item.description: Australia has banned social media for under-16s. We analyse how this impacts tabletop RPGs, from the safety of VTTs to the loss of Reddit LFG communities.

item.title: Wizard101 summons physical loot with Misty Mountain Gaming dice collection
item.description: Wizard101 teams up with Misty Mountain Gaming for three new dice sets, including a $99 Blue Sandstone collection and exclusive in-game wands.

item.title: Jason Carl departs World of Darkness to lead Dungeon Master University
item.description: Jason Carl announces his departure from World of Darkness and Paradox Interactive after 10 years. The Vampire: The Masquerade veteran joins D&D in a Castle.

item.title: The Sword of Cepheus 2nd Edition arrives in print on Amazon
item.description: Stellagama Publishing has released The Sword of Cepheus 2nd Edition in print on Amazon, bringing the 2d6 OGL fantasy RPG to a mainstream retailer.
